Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between step number and accuracy for two experiments. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A blue line, labeled "Ex1 Accuracy", begins at (0, 0.10) and increases to (10000, 0.35), then plateaus around 0.38 until (60000, 0.38). A turquoise line, labeled "Ex2 Accuracy", starts at (0, 0.25) and rises to (10000, 0.30), then continues to increase to (60000, 0.33). Both lines are represented with circular markers and solid line styles.
